findings.summary: `EditorAPI.toggleList` still does not fire the cursor-move callbacks, so the exact staleness this diff fixes remains reachable when a bullet is toggled on a heading block
findings.evidence: `toggleList` (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2871-2885) ends at `render()` with no `notifyStyleApplied()`, unlike the `setBlockType` this diff patched (and unlike the text-box editor's `toggleList`, packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1135, which does notify). It is reachable from the docs toolbar list buttons: packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:779/783 and packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-paragraph-group.tsx:176/194. When the caret sits in a `heading` block, `toggleList` calls `doc.setBlockType(block.id, 'list-item', …)`, so `getBlockType().type` becomes `list-item` → `getBlockLabel` returns "Normal text" (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-style-options.ts:106-114) and `blockTypeToStyleId` returns "normal" (ibid:121-129). With no callback fire, the toolbar's `refresh` (docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:317-324) never runs, so the Text style button keeps showing "Heading 1" and the menu keeps the Heading 1 checkmark — the same #792 symptom on a sibling entry point. The task note (docs/tasks/active/20260817-block-type-toolbar-refresh-todo.md:21-27) declares this unobservable because "TextStyleGroup never offers list-item", but the label is derived from the block's *actual* type, not from the offered options, so the heading→list-item transition is observable. Fix belongs in the new code's neighbour: add `notifyStyleApplied()` to `toggleList` (and, for consistency, `indent`/`outdent` at editor.ts:2904 and :2925).
